content.title: Spain's Telefonica shares drop on dividend cut, net loss
content.summary: Shares in Spanish telecoms giant Telefonica fell sharply on Tuesday after it posted a net loss for the first nine months of the year and announced it would cut its dividend by half in 2026.Telefonica said it would cut its dividend by half next year to 15 cents per share as part of a new five-year strategic plan as it seeks to reduce its debt.

content.title: Telefonica: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: MADRID (AP) — Telefonica SA (TEF) on Tuesday reported earnings of $316.8 million in its third quarter. The Madrid-based company said it had net income of 6 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for one-time gains and costs, came to 11 cents per share.
